relationships.subject: capsaicin-sensitive primary afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: Using neonatal capsaicin treatment, we identified that DOR agonist-induced thermal antinociception was mediated via receptors expressed on primary afferent sensory neurons but did not alter mechanical thresholds.

key_findings: Peripheral nerve injury increases DOR function and cell-surface DOR expression in deep (lamina IV-V) dorsal horn dendrites; DOR agonists produce CPP and naltrindole produces CPA only in PNI animals.

DOR agonist-enhanced thermal (but not mechanical) antinociception after PNI depends on capsaicin-sensitive primary afferents; DLT inhibits capsaicin-evoked spinal CGRP release more strongly after PNI.
